consent.banner.title: Cookies and storage
consent.banner.body: We use only first-party storage and nothing for marketing. Preferences such as your theme and language stay off until you allow them.
consent.banner.bodyChanged: Our cookie policy has changed, so we are asking again. Preferences stay off until you allow them.
consent.dialog.title: Cookie settings
consent.dialog.description: Choose what this site may keep on your device. You can change this at any time from the cookie settings link in the footer.
consent.category.essential.title: Essential
consent.category.essential.description: Always on, because the site cannot work without it: your session and security cookies, this consent record, the playback device id used for verified viewer counts, and your peer-to-peer choice.
consent.category.preferences.title: Preferences
consent.category.preferences.description: Remembers settings on this device so you do not have to set them again: theme, language, player volume and quality, chat display options and similar. If you decline, your choices last only for this browser tab.
consent.error.network: Your choice applies on this device. We could not record it just now and will try again later.
consent.error.rateLimited: Your choice applies on this device. Too many requests came from your network, so we will record it later.
consent.error.policyChanged: The cookie policy changed while you were choosing. Please choose again.
